svg.title: Section B-B: StayNest product stack
svg.desc: Section view through the StayNest stay-booking product, drawn like a building section. The interface floor holds four rooms: search and filters, wishlists, booking with a live price breakdown, and host analytics, built with Next.js server components. Below it, a hatched floor of typed REST routes; a row-level-security membrane; and a cross-hatched PostgreSQL foundation on Supabase. An end-to-end test line runs through every layer and unit-test markers sit inside individual layers.
